thomas: Quick announce from perf: we flipped the priority-smoother batcher canary. Short summary: p50 ~0%, p95 -11%, p99 -26%, est token-cost -10% on mixed web/chat for gpt-family models. :tada:

thomas: What it is: smoother introduces a lightweight priority decay window so high-priority short requests don't continuously preempt small batches, improving coalescence for tail workloads. It also adds a tiny pacer that absorbs brief spikes to avoid microburst evict churn.

ivy: Benchmarks?

thomas: Paste from canary run (1% prod replay + synthetic tails):
```
baseline (runtime/main): p50 35ms, p95 142ms, p99 498ms, token-cost=1.00
canary  (priority-smoother/v1): p50 35ms, p95 126ms, p99 369ms, token-cost=0.90
diff: p95 -16ms (-11.3%), p99 -129ms (-25.9%), cost -10%
```

rahul: Nice. Any quality regressions or request starvation for real-time flows?

thomas: Ran our realtime and tool-call evals. No semantic regressions. We added a safety override: requests with header x-live=true bypass the pacer to guarantee sub-10ms scheduling. Also set max_hold_ms=8 as a conservative default after tuning.

mae: Infra surprises? memory, scheduler thrash, driver issues?

thomas: Observed a brief increase in batch latency variance in the first 20m as the packer re-learned distribution; after we tuned the decay constant it stabilized. No OOMs or kernel faults. We did gate pacer off for pools with very low QPS.

ops-bot: deploy: priority-smoother/v1 -> canary on pool-gpu-a (3 instances) at 2026-02-02T02:12:03Z

ivy: Rollout plan and ops commands so oncall can follow?

thomas: Rollout plan: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with automated rollback if p99 increases or tool-error-rate >0.2%. Feature flags: "runtime.priority_smoother.enabled" (canary=true), "runtime.priority_smoother.max_hold_ms" (default=8), "runtime.priority_smoother.decay" (default=0.6). Rollout commands we used:
```
redwood deploy set-tag --pool pool-gpu-a --tag priority-smoother/v1 --pct 2
sleep 3600
redwood deploy set-tag --pool pool-gpu-a --tag priority-smoother/v1 --pct 10
# bump to 50% after 6h if metrics stable
```

rahul: Please upload eval CSVs and telemetry to the bench bucket; also add a Console tile for "pacer hold rate" and "x-live bypass rate".

thomas: Uploaded artifacts to s3://ci-redwood/benchmarks/priority-smoother/v1 and filed the console tickets. Added telemetry counter for "pacer_hold_ms" and "priority_demote_count".

ivy: Dedicated clusters? customers opt-in?

thomas: Default is off for Dedicated. We added a per-customer toggle and a determinism test harness. Product will handle outreach before enabling.

mae: :rocket: great work. Small follow-up: can we expose an explainer in the Console docs so customers understand x-live semantics?

thomas: Will add a short doc and a note in #eng-notices. Closing: starting 2% canary now, targeting full roll in 48h with rollback gates. I'll post progress here.
